recognized_test_commands.command: /bin/bash -lc "grep -R -n 'EmitAuditEvent(context.Background()\\|EmitAuditEvent(context.TODO()\\|&UserLogin\\|&SessionStart' lib/events/*test.go | head -35; grep -R -n 'type .*WriteCloser\\|struct.*WriteCloser' lib/events/*test.go | head; gofmt -w lib/events/emitter.go lib/events/multilog.go lib/service/service.go; GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./lib/events ./lib/service"
/bin/bash -lc 'gofmt -w lib/events/emitter.go lib/events/multilog.go && GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./lib/events ./lib/service && git diff --check'

limitations: Shell/script/code-mode edits and tests may not be recognized. A failed invocation can be an environment error. Red/green does not prove the right assertion or test-first. Absence of recognized evidence is not noncompliance. Inspect full events and checkpoint.
